entries.title: Player_Romus: ""People love a good picture. I supp..."
entries.dialogueText: "People love a good picture. I suppose this is what democracy looks like."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I suppose we should smile for the..."
entries.dialogueText: "I suppose we should smile for the cameras."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""These moments... They’ll be all we..."
entries.dialogueText: "These moments... They’ll be all we have to remember when the dust settles."

entries.speaker: Manus Sazon
entries.title: Manus Sazon: ""Absolutely.""
entries.dialogueText: "Absolutely."

entries.speaker: Daria de Rava
entries.title: Daria de Rava: ""Naturally.""
entries.dialogueText: "Naturally."

entries.speaker: Adarfo Sotelato
entries.title: Adarfo Sotelato: "“Only if you mean it.”"
entries.dialogueText: “Only if you mean it.”

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "We passed through the foyer and the..."
entries.dialogueText: We passed through the foyer and the hall, empty except for us, until we reached the chamber.

entries.speaker: Daria de Rava
entries.title: Daria de Rava: ""I'd say democracy is a bit more co..."
entries.dialogueText: "I'd say democracy is a bit more complicated than that."

entries.speaker: Adarfo Sotelato
entries.title: Adarfo Sotelato: ""Some of us will be remembered more..."
entries.dialogueText: "Some of us will be remembered more fondly than others."

entries.speaker: Manus Sazon
entries.title: Manus Sazon: ""I think there's more to it than ju..."
entries.dialogueText: "I think there's more to it than just a photo."

entries.speaker: Adarfo Sotelato
entries.title: Adarfo Sotelato: "“I think the people would prefer ac..."
entries.dialogueText: “I think the people would prefer actual change, not just a moment for the camera.”

entries.speaker: Daria de Rava
entries.title: Daria de Rava: ""I hope it’s not just the pictures..."
entries.dialogueText: "I hope it’s not just the pictures they remember."

entries.speaker: Manus Sazon
entries.title: Manus Sazon: "“And what a picture it will make.""
entries.dialogueText: “And what a picture it will make."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "After the photos, we headed up the..."
entries.dialogueText: After the photos, we headed up the steps and entered the House of Delegates.

entries.speaker: Manus Sazon
entries.title: Manus Sazon: ""A symbol of our people's strength..."
entries.dialogueText: "A symbol of our people's strength and the future we're building."

entries.speaker: Daria de Rava
entries.title: Daria de Rava: ""Rizia's future is in that case. To..."
entries.dialogueText: "Rizia's future is in that case. To think this is what we've worked so hard for..."

entries.speaker: Adarfo Sotelato
entries.title: Adarfo Sotelato: ""We’ll see if it truly represents a..."
entries.dialogueText: "We’ll see if it truly represents all of us, or just the few who hold the power."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "At the center of the room near the..."
entries.dialogueText: At the center of the room near the podiums, a newly refurbished secure display case proudly showcased Rizia’s new constitution.

entries.speaker: Manus Sazon
entries.title: Manus Sazon: ""Thank you, Your Majesty. Your supp..."
entries.dialogueText: "Thank you, Your Majesty. Your support will do more than you realize."

entries.speaker: Manus Sazon
entries.title: Manus Sazon: ""I understand your position, Your M..."
entries.dialogueText: "I understand your position, Your Majesty. I appreciate your time regardless."

entries.speaker: Manus Sazon
entries.title: Manus Sazon: ""You will?! That's great! You have..."
entries.dialogueText: "You will?! That's great! You have my sincerest gratitude. Thank you, Your Majesty!"

entries.speaker: Manus Sazon
entries.title: Manus Sazon: ""Very well. Just thought I'd ask.""
entries.dialogueText: "Very well. Just thought I'd ask."

entries.speaker: Daria de Rava
entries.title: Daria de Rava: ""You will?! That’s wonderful! I’m t..."
entries.dialogueText: "You will?! That’s wonderful! I’m truly grateful. Thank you, Your Majesty!"

entries.speaker: Daria de Rava
entries.title: Daria de Rava: ""Well, I appreciate your time regar..."
entries.dialogueText: "Well, I appreciate your time regardless."

entries.speaker: Daria de Rava
entries.title: Daria de Rava: ""Fair enough. I won’t press the mat..."
entries.dialogueText: "Fair enough. I won’t press the matter."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Manus reached out and shook my hand..."
entries.dialogueText: Manus reached out and shook my hand, his grip firm with gratitude.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Manus gave a polite nod before he t..."
entries.dialogueText: Manus gave a polite nod before he turned and left.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Daria reached out and shook my hand..."
entries.dialogueText: Daria reached out and shook my hand, her eyes shining with gratitude.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "As the doors closed behind him, I t..."
entries.dialogueText: As the doors closed behind him, I took in the desolate room.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I walked toward the seats, each one..."
entries.dialogueText: I walked toward the seats, each one now a symbol of the uncertain future that awaited us.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Daria gave a polite nod before she..."
entries.dialogueText: Daria gave a polite nod before she turned and left.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "When he realized he had been shakin..."
entries.dialogueText: When he realized he had been shaking my hand far longer than necessary, he quickly withdrew and gave a slight bow before leaving the chamber.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "As the doors closed behind her, I t..."
entries.dialogueText: As the doors closed behind her, I took in the desolate room.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I caught sight of the display case..."
entries.dialogueText: I caught sight of the display case once more. What it represented was impossible to ignore.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""No matter what happens, no one can..."
entries.dialogueText: "No matter what happens, no one can rewrite what I have done."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I looked around the chamber once mo..."
entries.dialogueText: I looked around the chamber once more, but the only reply was the hush of an empty room.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""They call this progress, yet they..."
entries.dialogueText: "They call this progress, yet they stand on the foundation I built."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Perhaps this will lead Rizia to so..."
entries.dialogueText: "Perhaps this will lead Rizia to something greater. Perhaps my rule was the bridge that made it possible."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""My time is ending, but Rizia will..."
entries.dialogueText: "My time is ending, but Rizia will endure. It must."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "With nothing left to say, I turned..."
entries.dialogueText: With nothing left to say, I turned to leave, carrying with me the knowledge that one chapter had ended and another was beginning.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I’ll gladly lend my support to you..."
entries.dialogueText: "I’ll gladly lend my support to your cause."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I can’t back this message. There a..."
entries.dialogueText: "I can’t back this message. There are more important issues right now."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""If mentioning your plans will brin..."
entries.dialogueText: "If mentioning your plans will bring hope to the people, I’ll talk about them. Though I’m not sure it will be enough to change minds."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I’ll mention it. Security is vital..."
entries.dialogueText: "I’ll mention it. Security is vital, and if my words can help, I’ll gladly support it."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""The policy is sound, but I can’t e..."
entries.dialogueText: "The policy is sound, but I can’t endorse your campaign directly. However, I’ll mention the need for security."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I can’t back this message. There a..."
entries.dialogueText: "I can’t back this message. There are more important issues right now."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I see the value in your message, a..."
entries.dialogueText: "I see the value in your message, and I’ll openly support you. Stability and security are paramount."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I won't just mention it. I will op..."
entries.dialogueText: "I won't just mention it. I will openly endorse you as a candidate."

entries.speaker: Daria de Rava
entries.title: Daria de Rava: ""An endorsement from the King would..."
entries.dialogueText: "An endorsement from the King would show the people that we are working toward rebuilding from the ground up..."

entries.speaker: Daria de Rava
entries.title: Daria de Rava: ""Highlighting that in your upcoming..."
entries.dialogueText: "Highlighting that in your upcoming speech would show the people there’s a clear and secure path forward."

entries.speaker: Daria de Rava
entries.title: Daria de Rava: ""If you could mention this in your..."
entries.dialogueText: "If you could mention this in your speech, it would reassure the people that we’re not just protecting what you've built, but working on Rizia's future security and growth."

entries.speaker: Daria de Rava
entries.title: Daria de Rava: ""With living conditions being what..."
entries.dialogueText: "With living conditions being what they are, I’m running on a campaign focused on strengthening our economy and ensuring the security of every citizen."

entries.speaker: Daria de Rava
entries.title: Daria de Rava: ""That stability doesn't come withou..."
entries.dialogueText: "That stability doesn't come without effort, and it takes strong leadership to get us there."

entries.speaker: Daria de Rava
entries.title: Daria de Rava: ""It would remind them that the RNC..."
entries.dialogueText: "It would remind them that the RNC is not just maintaining stability -- we’re securing their future."

entries.speaker: Daria de Rava
entries.title: Daria de Rava: ""Given our current living standards..."
entries.dialogueText: "Given our current living standards, my campaign is centered on securing our prosperity and solidifying Rizia’s position as a regional powerhouse."

entries.speaker: Daria de Rava
entries.title: Daria de Rava: ""I’m running a campaign focused on..."
entries.dialogueText: "I’m running a campaign focused on strengthening our economy and ensuring the security of every citizen."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: "“You mean... everyone more likely t..."
entries.dialogueText: “You mean... everyone more likely to vote for you.”

entries.speaker: Manus Sazon
entries.title: Manus Sazon: "“I mean everyone, Your Majesty. Eve..."
entries.dialogueText: “I mean everyone, Your Majesty. Even those who would rather see me lose.”

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I suppose some still need convinci..."
entries.dialogueText: "I suppose some still need convincing that their vote actually matters."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""This is all happening so fast.""
entries.dialogueText: "This is all happening so fast."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""It sounds like things are moving i..."
entries.dialogueText: "It sounds like things are moving in the right direction."

entries.speaker: Daria de Rava
entries.title: Daria de Rava: "“I mean everyone, Your Majesty. Eve..."
entries.dialogueText: “I mean everyone, Your Majesty. Even those who would rather see me lose.”

entries.speaker: Adarfo Sotelato
entries.title: Adarfo Sotelato: ""I mean everyone, even those who mi..."
entries.dialogueText: "I mean everyone, even those who might not vote in my favor."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Maybe we should put the ballot box..."
entries.dialogueText: "Maybe we should put the ballot boxes in pubs -- that would get their attention."

entries.speaker: Manus Sazon
entries.title: Manus Sazon: ""Fast, yes -- but that doesn't mean..."
entries.dialogueText: "Fast, yes -- but that doesn't mean rushed. We've been thorough where it matters most."

entries.speaker: Daria de Rava
entries.title: Daria de Rava: ""Fast, yes -- but not careless or r..."
entries.dialogueText: "Fast, yes -- but not careless or rushed. We've been thorough where it matters most."

entries.speaker: Adarfo Sotelato
entries.title: Adarfo Sotelato: ""It may feel fast to you, but for t..."
entries.dialogueText: "It may feel fast to you, but for those who've spent their whole lives without a voice... it's been painfully slow."

entries.speaker: Manus Sazon
entries.title: Manus Sazon: ""A valid concern, but one we are ad..."
entries.dialogueText: "A valid concern, but one we are addressing."

entries.speaker: Daria de Rava
entries.title: Daria de Rava: ""While that may get attention, it's..."
entries.dialogueText: "While that may get attention, it's not the kind we need. Instead, we've focused on strengthening the process itself, which will lay the foundation for genuine trust."

entries.speaker: Manus Sazon
entries.title: Manus Sazon: "“As entertaining as that would be,..."
entries.dialogueText: “As entertaining as that would be, we’re still focused on ensuring that everyone has access to a proper, legitimate vote."

entries.speaker: Adarfo Sotelato
entries.title: Adarfo Sotelato: ""This isn't a joke. The people are..."
entries.dialogueText: "This isn't a joke. The people are counting on us to get this right."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "As the motorcade slowed at the inte..."
entries.dialogueText: As the motorcade slowed at the intersection, my gaze lingered on a city worker balanced on a ladder.

entries.speaker: Daria de Rava
entries.title: Daria de Rava: ""It’s a valid concern, but we are w..."
entries.dialogueText: "It’s a valid concern, but we are working on it."

entries.speaker: Adarfo Sotelato
entries.title: Adarfo Sotelato: ""True, especially after experiencin..."
entries.dialogueText: "True, especially after experiencing Rizia's sham of an electoral system."

entries.speaker: Daria de Rava
entries.title: Daria de Rava: "“Certainly.""
entries.dialogueText: “Certainly."

entries.speaker: Adarfo Sotelato
entries.title: Adarfo Sotelato: ""They are.""
entries.dialogueText: "They are."

entries.speaker: Manus Sazon
entries.title: Manus Sazon: ""Moreover, centralizing the governm..."
entries.dialogueText: "Moreover, centralizing the government has allowed us to provide uniform oversight across all regions."

entries.speaker: Daria de Rava
entries.title: Daria de Rava: ""Moreover, centralizing the governm..."
entries.dialogueText: "Moreover, centralizing the government, while it has led to a loss of autonomy for the regions, has allowed us to provide uniform oversight across all areas."

entries.speaker: Adarfo Sotelato
entries.title: Adarfo Sotelato: ""Moreover, centralizing power has a..."
entries.dialogueText: "Moreover, centralizing power has allowed us to employ strict oversight across all regions."

entries.speaker: Manus Sazon
entries.title: Manus Sazon: ""Absolutely.""
entries.dialogueText: "Absolutely."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""What does the data say about voter..."
entries.dialogueText: "What does the data say about voters' top issues?"

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Daria's expression stiffens for a m..."
entries.dialogueText: Daria's expression stiffens for a moment, but she maintained her composure.

entries.speaker: Daria de Rava
entries.title: Daria de Rava: ""Oh, I know. I was worried it wasn’..."
entries.dialogueText: "Oh, I know. I was worried it wasn’t big enough."

entries.speaker: Daria de Rava
entries.title: Daria de Rava: ""Kidding aside, I believe leaders s..."
entries.dialogueText: "Kidding aside, I believe leaders should be seen. The people deserve to know who they’re voting for. Simple as that."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "She gestured outside."
entries.dialogueText: She gestured outside.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Adarfo didn't flinch."
entries.dialogueText: Adarfo didn't flinch.

entries.speaker: Adarfo Sotelato
entries.title: Adarfo Sotelato: ""I considered something smaller, bu..."
entries.dialogueText: "I considered something smaller, but then I thought -- why disappoint?"

entries.speaker: Adarfo Sotelato
entries.title: Adarfo Sotelato: ""Seriously though, a leader should..."
entries.dialogueText: "Seriously though, a leader should be seen. The people need to know who stands for them."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He gestured outside."
entries.dialogueText: He gestured outside.

entries.speaker: Daria de Rava
entries.title: Daria de Rava: ""Yes, Your Majesty. Everyone gets a..."
entries.dialogueText: "Yes, Your Majesty. Everyone gets a voice in this -- equally."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Adarfo smirked."
entries.dialogueText: Adarfo smirked.

entries.speaker: Adarfo Sotelato
entries.title: Adarfo Sotelato: ""Yes, your vote counts -- just like..."
entries.dialogueText: "Yes, your vote counts -- just like everyone else's."

entries.speaker: Adarfo Sotelato
entries.title: Adarfo Sotelato: ""Well, we can’t all rely on a crown..."
entries.dialogueText: "Well, we can’t all rely on a crown to do the talking."

entries.speaker: Daria de Rava
entries.title: Daria de Rava: ""A fair concern. But I believe the..."
entries.dialogueText: "A fair concern. But I believe the people see beyond the spectacle."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Through the glass, I saw volunteers..."
entries.dialogueText: Through the glass, I saw volunteers at a registration booth outside the retirement community, guiding senior citizens through the process.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""No time for small talk. The hall o..."
entries.dialogueText: "No time for small talk. The hall of the people is waiting."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""It would behoove you to remember t..."
entries.dialogueText: "It would behoove you to remember that you are only Prime Minister because of my successful reforms."

entries.speaker: Adarfo Sotelato
entries.title: Adarfo Sotelato: ""I understand. You'll adjust to you..."
entries.dialogueText: "I understand. You'll adjust to your new role soon enough."

entries.speaker: Adarfo Sotelato
entries.title: Adarfo Sotelato: ""I do thank you for keeping the nob..."
entries.dialogueText: "I do thank you for keeping the noble houses from causing trouble. But I or one of my comrades would have wound up in this car with or without you."

entries.speaker: Adarfo Sotelato
entries.title: Adarfo Sotelato: ""I'm behind the wheel, Toras. You'r..."
entries.dialogueText: "I'm behind the wheel, Toras. You're just along for the ride."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""How is Vina? She won't say a word..."
entries.dialogueText: "How is Vina? She won't say a word to me."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Manus gave me a thin-lipped smile."
entries.dialogueText: Manus gave me a thin-lipped smile.

entries.speaker: Manus Sazon
entries.title: Manus Sazon: ""She's apoplectic, of course, as is..."
entries.dialogueText: "She's apoplectic, of course, as is my mother. But they'll be fine."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""About Vina's inheritance. I hope y..."
entries.dialogueText: "About Vina's inheritance. I hope you know it's nothing personal."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Manus gave me a thin-lipped smile."
entries.dialogueText: Manus gave me a thin-lipped smile.

entries.speaker: Manus Sazon
entries.title: Manus Sazon: ""Don't tell the Princess, but I ful..."
entries.dialogueText: "Don't tell the Princess, but I fully approve your decision."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""How is Vina?""
entries.dialogueText: "How is Vina?"

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Manus gave me a patient smile."
entries.dialogueText: Manus gave me a patient smile.

entries.speaker: Manus Sazon
entries.title: Manus Sazon: ""Your Majesty, I'd appreciate it if..."
entries.dialogueText: "Your Majesty, I'd appreciate it if we saved such discussions for family occasions."

entries.speaker: Manus Sazon
entries.title: Manus Sazon: ""The King of Rizia is to be respect..."
entries.dialogueText: "The King of Rizia is to be respected, whether or not he leads the government."

entries.speaker: Daria de Rava
entries.title: Daria de Rava: ""I would never disrespect the King..."
entries.dialogueText: "I would never disrespect the King of Rizia, Your Majesty."

entries.speaker: Manus Sazon
entries.title: Manus Sazon: ""It's our people who determine the..."
entries.dialogueText: "It's our people who determine the direction. We just turn the wheel as they see fit."

entries.speaker: Daria de Rava
entries.title: Daria de Rava: ""I'm grateful to be allowed behind..."
entries.dialogueText: "I'm grateful to be allowed behind the wheel."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""This feels odd. I'm not used to sh..."
entries.dialogueText: "This feels odd. I'm not used to sharing a car."

entries.speaker: Manus Sazon
entries.title: Manus Sazon: ""Odd or not, this is the new order.""
entries.dialogueText: "Odd or not, this is the new order."

entries.speaker: Daria de Rava
entries.title: Daria de Rava: ""I never dreamed I'd ride side by s..."
entries.dialogueText: "I never dreamed I'd ride side by side with the King of Rizia, let alone have powers that supercede his."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus_Italic
entries.title: Player_Romus_Italic: "I said nothing. We rode on in silen..."
entries.dialogueText: I said nothing. We rode on in silence.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I was just fastening the last butto..."
entries.dialogueText: I was just fastening the last button of my coat when a firm knock on my chamber door caught my attention.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Nothing says ‘progress’ like swapp..."
entries.dialogueText: "Nothing says ‘progress’ like swapping a sign."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Even the streets must bear witness..."
entries.dialogueText: "Even the streets must bear witness to the new order."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Good. Let the city reflect its new..."
entries.dialogueText: "Good. Let the city reflect its new reality."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Huh. You couldn't come up with any..."
entries.dialogueText: "Huh. You couldn't come up with anything better?"

entries.speaker: Adarfo Sotelato
entries.title: Adarfo Sotelato: ""Funny... a king admiring the handi..."
entries.dialogueText: "Funny... a king admiring the handiwork of the people."

entries.speaker: Adarfo Sotelato
entries.title: Adarfo Sotelato: ""One more thing...""
entries.dialogueText: "One more thing..."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Yes?""
entries.dialogueText: "Yes?"

entries.speaker: Adarfo Sotelato
entries.title: Adarfo Sotelato: ""I don't believe Rizia still needs..."
entries.dialogueText: "I don't believe Rizia still needs a king. But our people do."

entries.speaker: Adarfo Sotelato
entries.title: Adarfo Sotelato: ""No matter how much I've tried to c..."
entries.dialogueText: "No matter how much I've tried to convince them otherwise, some part of them is in thrall to the Crown and whoever's wearing it."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He lowered his head in acknowledgem..."
entries.dialogueText: He lowered his head in acknowledgement -- the closest he'd ever come to bowing to me -- before making his exit.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "After a moment, the back door of th..."
entries.dialogueText: After a moment, the back door of the nearest car opened, and there he was, seated inside.

entries.speaker: Manus Sazon
entries.title: Manus Sazon: ""Your electoral reforms set the sta..."
entries.dialogueText: "Your electoral reforms set the stage for fair elections. We've also established an Electoral Commission to make the process more transparent than ever."

entries.speaker: Manus Sazon
entries.title: Manus Sazon: ""With our new Electoral Commission..."
entries.dialogueText: "With our new Electoral Commission now fully operational, the process is more transparent than ever."

entries.speaker: Daria de Rava
entries.title: Daria de Rava: ""Your electoral reforms may have de..."
entries.dialogueText: "Your electoral reforms may have dealt a blow to the RNC at the time, but they did prime the populace to believe their vote is important."

entries.speaker: Daria de Rava
entries.title: Daria de Rava: ""We've also established an Electora..."
entries.dialogueText: "We've also established an Electoral Commission to oversee the process and eliminate the possibility of voter fraud."

entries.speaker: Daria de Rava
entries.title: Daria de Rava: ""We've established an Electoral Com..."
entries.dialogueText: "We've established an Electoral Commission to oversee the process and eliminate the possibility of voter fraud."

entries.speaker: Adarfo Sotelato
entries.title: Adarfo Sotelato: ""Fortunately, your electoral reform..."
entries.dialogueText: "Fortunately, your electoral reforms set the stage for fair elections. And with our new independent Electoral Commission now fully operational, we’re almost finished training the officials who'll oversee the process."

entries.speaker: Adarfo Sotelato
entries.title: Adarfo Sotelato: ""With our new independent Electoral..."
entries.dialogueText: "With our new independent Electoral Commission now fully operational, we’re almost finished training the officials who'll oversee the process."

entries.speaker: Manus Sazon
entries.title: Manus Sazon: ""Obviously, care will need to be ta..."
entries.dialogueText: "Obviously, care will need to be taken to ensure uniform oversight across our various provinces."

entries.speaker: Daria de Rava
entries.title: Daria de Rava: ""With Rizia still not centralized,..."
entries.dialogueText: "With Rizia still not centralized, care will need to be taken to ensure uniform oversight across our various provinces."

entries.speaker: Adarfo Sotelato
